<subject>Re: Lumière Santé, Lyon Database</subject>
<body>
Bernard,

We've completed a review this morning to try to fill in missing pieces of information on patient admission patterns, surgical scheduling history, and inter-departmental transfers for Lyon and have not come up with anything yet. Would you know of any data sources which would assist us in our efforts?

Thanks,  
Adrien Thibault  
Executive Assistant  
Lumière Santé SAS  
adrien.thibault@lumieresante.fr  
+33 4 72 00 12 34  
12 Rue du Praticien, 69003 Lyon, France
</body>
<quoted>
----- Original Message -----
From: Adrien <adrien.thibault@lumieresante.fr>
To: Bernard Schmitt <bernard.schmitt@lumieresante.fr>
Cc: Édouard Pruvost <edouard.pruvost@lumieresante.fr>; Aimé Ruiz <aime.ruiz@lumieresante.fr>; Honoré Allard <honore.allard@lumieresante.fr>
Sent: Wednesday, 08 January 2025 18:20
Subject: Lumière Santé, Lyon Database

Bernard,

Below, I have summarized Clinique Espérance's work on the Lyon database to date. The "Inter_Site_Network" file shows the topology and links between units in our model and "Expand_Lyon_Data_011000.xls" details the existing departmental information that we have compiled to date. Total bed capacity closely matches reported figures as shown in "C&B_0110.xls". Reported Lyon total in 2023 is 860 beds and that in the Clinique Espérance database is 840 beds through 2023.

Lyon

We are currently working on the development of hourly admission shaping, seasonal staffing allocation, and the gathering of inter-hospital transfer information. Bernard, we will try to contact you tomorrow (Thursday – Australia or Wednesday – Casablanca) to answer any questions that you may have on this information.

Sincerely,  
Adrien Thibault
</quoted>
